channel.title: The Western Producer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: Reduced Argentine soybean harvest, bigger crush says USDA attaché
item.description: Argentina is expected to reap 48 million tonnes of soybeans in 2025/26, the United States Department of Agriculture attaché in Buenos Aires said in a report released on Feb. 25. That’s slightly lower than the USDA’s official estimate of 48.50 million tonnes.

item.title: Saskatchewan Cattle Association says no to traceability amendments
item.description: The Saskatchewan Cattle Association wants regulatory amendments regarding traceability stopped.

item.title: Unified ag front urged for Next Policy Framework
item.description: Panelists at the Canadian Federation of Agriculture (CFA) annual general meeting say agriculture groups must stay focused and united in consultations for the recently-announced next policy framework

item.title: Wheat breeding system no longer works: review
item.description: A Canadian Wheat Research Coalition report, published Feb. 26, says the status quo is not an option for Canada’s wheat breeding system. It must be transformed, by farmers.

item.title: China suspends some agricultural tariffs on Canada
item.description: China said on Friday it would suspend some tariffs on Canadian agricultural products imposed during a trade spat between Beijing and Ottawa, after Prime Minister Mark Carney struck an initial deal with Beijing during a visit in January.

item.title: Spain alerts WHO of swine flu virus believed to have been transmitted between people
item.description: Spain has alerted the World Health Organization of what it believes to be a person-to-person transmission of the swine flu virus in its A(H1N1)v variant, a spokesperson for health authorities in the Catalonia region confirmed to Reuters on Friday.

item.title: Olymel parent company sees increased earnings in 2025
item.description: Meat processor Olymel recorded sales of nearly $4.9 billion in 2025 helped by strong pork and chicken markets said parent company Sollio Cooperative Group.

item.title: Canola meal seen to be good fit for dog food
item.description: Research suggests that dogs want canola meal in their diet. If more pet food manufacturers used it as an ingredient, it could be worth hundreds of millions or billions in additional sales of canola meal

item.title: Key information to know if you’re heading to Canada’s Farm Show
item.description: Canada’s Farm Show is returning to the Regina REAL District for 2026, bringing three days of equipment, technology, crop products and education sessions to Canadian farmers.

item.title: Refined flour faces significant attack in the U.S.
item.description: U.S. FDA is reviewing the GRAS status of refined flour. If it loses that status it could be pulled from the market.
